author: Pooja Nair (UX Research)
note: Interviewed 14 churned new users. 9 said onboarding felt 'too long'; 2 mentioned badges, both positively.

author: Support team
note: Top uninstall-survey reason in 2024 was 'too many notifications'; complaints dropped after pushes were cut to 1/day on iOS.

author: Data team
note: EXP-19 conversion fell back to +6% two weeks after the Diwali sale ended.
